name: Syed Nafiz Reja Hasib
identity: Computational structural mechanics, superelastic alloys, thin-shell stability, and low-carbon seismic systems.
bio: Two years of cyclic-durability testing on superelastic NiTi at Denco Manufacturing (following a BEng in Civil Engineering, SWPU) led me to build verified mechanics solvers to test where structural efficiency meets seismic and carbon limits.
